worldcombat.skill.barbbarrage.summary: Shake loose a fan of countless toxic barbs. The number of barbs grows with level and speed, and the total power is split across them; if even one lands it may poison the target. Against a target already poisoned the whole volley is doubled.
worldcombat.skill.barbbarrage.descriptio: One volley fires %1$s barbs fanned across %2$s degrees along the aim direction (a bare empty shot works too); each barb flies and strikes on its own, and a barb that meets a block only sticks there without further damage.

The volley deals about %1$s physical damage in total, split across its barbs on hit; each barb flies at %2$s blocks per tick. Against a target already poisoned or badly poisoned the whole volley is doubled.

After the volley, if at least one barb landed there is a %1$s chance to poison the struck target that took the most barbs for %2$s (ties go to the first one hit); each barb that lands shoves its target %3$s blocks along the aim.
worldcombat.skill.barbbarrage.use.1: Fan pressure over a group and maybe poison one of them
worldcombat.skill.barbbarrage.preference: On: barbs x1.4 and poison chance x1.15, but volley power x0.85 and about 0.1/0.15 s more recovery and cooldown. Off: fewer, heavier barbs that hit a single target harder.
Beyond this distance the user closes in before firing a volley.
When on, the user may leave its post to find a firing line; when off, it only fires on what it can reach from where it stands.
